![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Force `validation_status` to `'fail'` when `inputDiagnostics.length > 0` to ensure the validator fails closed under all circumstances, even if the checks list is modified or missing the `stale_input_references_rejected` check.

```suggestion
    validatorResult.summary.failing_check_count = validatorResult.checks.filter((item) => item.status !== 'pass').length;
    validatorResult.summary.validation_status = 'fail';
  }
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Ensure that parsed input shape failures, missing files, or malformed entries flow into validation by adding a validator check (such as verifying that no input diagnostics were recorded) so that the validator fails closed.
</details>

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Explicitly assert that all expected checks are present, pass, and are emitted in strict byte-order by ID, to fully adhere to the repository's general rule for package validators.

```suggestion
    const checkIds = validatorResult.checks.map((c) => c.id);
    expect(checkIds).toEqual([
      'count_conservation_preserved',
      'deterministic_ordering_preserved',
      'duplicate_ids_rejected',
      'full_source_coverage_not_claimed',
      'invalid_posture_enums_rejected',
      'missing_edge_endpoints_rejected',
      'schema_sections_present',
      'stale_input_references_rejected',
    ]);
    expect(validatorResult.checks.every((c) => c.status === 'pass')).toBe(true);
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When writing unit tests for package validators, explicitly assert that all expected checks are present, pass, and are emitted in strict byte-order by ID.
</details>

Fixed in b78ed591e: input diagnostics now force the runtime spine validator summary to fail even when the normal check list has no failures.
Fixed in b78ed591e: the happy-path runtime spine test now asserts the validator check IDs in exact byte-order and asserts every check passes.
Fixed in b78ed591e: added fail-closed fixture coverage for missing manifest input and malformed contract input.
Fixed in b78ed591e: posture diagnostics now guard missing contract data and malformed/null posture or node entries without throwing.
Fixed in b78ed591e: stale-reference diagnostics now classify malformed/null source entries as critical diagnostics instead of throwing.
Fixed in b78ed591e: duplicate-ID and missing-endpoint validation now uses guarded ID extraction and reports malformed edge entries fail-closed.
Fixed in b78ed591e: deterministic-ordering validation now requires valid non-empty IDs and uses guarded ID access so malformed section entries fail closed.
